The '''Inner Kuat Transfer Zone''', also referred to as the '''Inner Kuat Traffic Zone''', was an area of space surrounding the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. Since commercial and passenger [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were not allowed into the Kuat system proper, all traffic was required to stop at one of the three immense [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] located in the Inner Kuat Transfer Zone. The [[Kuat Passenger Port]] was responsible for all passenger traffic, the [[Kuat Freight Port]] handled cargo, and the [[Imperial Transfer Post]] was restricted to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessels.
